operations.description: Updates the recurring series on an existing job. (required scope jobs:write)

occurrenceCount.description: The number of occurrences after which the recurrence series stops. Must not be provided together with BigChange.BO.RestApi.Application.JobRecurrences.Models.UpdateJobRecurrenceModel.EndDateAt
